segments.name: Prepaid Card Products
segments.description: Provides prepaid card programs and processing, plus life science software, to corporate, consumer and government customers across the prepaid card lifecycle.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one business, a vertically integrated provider of prepaid card products and processing services.

revenueModel.text: Corporate, consumer and government customers pay fees across the prepaid card lifecycle, including cardholder fees, interchange, card program management, transaction claims processing, breakage and settlement income.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues include fees generated from cardholder fees, interchange, card program management fees, transaction claims processing fees, breakage, and settlement income.
